product_metadata.title: Tirrinia Insulated Wine Gift carrier - 3 Bottle Travel Padded Wine Carry Cooler Tote Bag with Handle and Adjustable Shoulder Strap, Black
features: PORTABLE DESIGN - Sturdy handle and adjustable shoulder strap with stainless steel buckle of this wine gift carrier bag help you carry your wine to anywhere. Great for transporting wine to parties, wine dinners, restaurants, pool or beach parties, picnics, concerts and sporting events.

THERMAL- INSULATED ＆ PADDED - PU thermal insulated material and 600D premium polyester surface fabric with 5mm PE foam padding protect your bottles of wine from external collision, keep 3 bottles of wine intact and well chilled for hours.

PROTECT YOUR WINE BOTTLE FROM SHATTERING - The inside padded divider keeps 3 bottles of wine separate and prevent them from crashing with each other. It's also flexible, you can use the wine gift bag as a insulated cooler bag for transporting water, beverage or beer….

AMPLE STORAGE SPACE - 11.5" x 4" x 13" (L x W x H), the wine gift carrier tote has ample space for 3 normal size bottles of wine. The front pocket facilitate you to hold small things, such like, paper towel or wine openers.

IDEAL WINE LOVER GIFT - Elegant look and pratical design make this wine gift carrier suitable for all age wine lovers. If your families or friends are wine drinkers and love to share wine with others, this wine gift carrier would be a excellent gift for them.
